name: summarize_climate_by_region
description: Summarize a climate layer over a region using statistics such as mean, median, min, max, standard deviation, and percentiles. The function can summarize an already-loaded climate artifact or load a registered climate layer internally.

input_artifact.description: Optional already-loaded or clipped climate artifact containing GeoJSON features and a numeric value column.

variable.description: Climate variable to summarize. Examples: 'extreme_heat_days', 'tasmax', 'heat_index'. Required if input_artifact is not provided.

region_name.description: Region to summarize over. Examples: 'Fiji', 'Tonga', 'Melanesia'. Required if input_artifact is not provided.

period.description: Projection period. Examples: '2050s', '2060s', '2100s'. Required if input_artifact is not provided.

value_column.description: Optional numeric column to summarize. If omitted, the function uses the value_column metadata from the input artifact.

statistics.description: Optional list of statistics to compute. Supported examples: count, missing_count, mean, median, min, max, std, sum, variance, p10, p25, p75, p90, p95.

clip_to_region.description: Whether to clip the climate layer to the requested region before summarizing.

region_artifact.description: Optional resolved region artifact from resolve_region. Used for clipping if clip_to_region is true.

include_geometry.description: Whether to include the summarized input GeoJSON in the output. Usually false because the main output is a summary table.

return_geometry_format.description: Geometry output format. Currently only GeoJSON is supported.

input_artifact_type.description: Artifact type of the input that was summarized.

input_layer_id.description: Layer ID of the input artifact, if available.

source_variable.description: Original source variable, if different from the derived variable.

value_column.description: Numeric column used for the summary.

table.description: Table-friendly version of the summary, with statistic and value fields.

valid_count.description: Number of features with valid numeric values.

missing_count.description: Number of features with missing or non-numeric values.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minx, miny, maxx, maxy].

geojson.description: Optional GeoJSON FeatureCollection, included only if include_geometry is true.

provenance.description: Information about how the summary was computed and the parent artifact used.
